headline: NQ is +0.4% near its overnight high on SK Hynix's blowout quarter, pointing to a third straight open above the prior day's NDX high. Small long only while NQ holds above Tuesday's settle; the Fed (2:00 PM) and Microsoft/Alphabet (after the close) cap the morning.
session_note: Cash open 9:30 AM ET (10:30 AM Atlantic) · morning window · FOMC 2:00 PM ET

flip.long: Stays LONG while NQ holds above ~29,880 (≈ NDX 29,720, Tuesday's high) after the open. Adds conviction above the overnight high 29,989.25 and the 30,000 round number.
flip.short: NQ fills the gap and loses Tuesday's settle (29,812.00; ≈ NDX 29,651, Tuesday's close). Stronger below the overnight low (29,783.75), especially if WTI pushes through ~$103 or the 10-year holds above 5.00%.

thesis: There's a small long edge at the open again, but it's low conviction. The NDX rose 1.3% Tuesday to 29,651.44 (range 29,340.54–29,719.63), its second straight gain [1]. Overnight, Nasdaq-100 futures rose on chips after SK Hynix posted a record quarter (operating profit +632% y/y) and a ~KRW 100tln shareholder return; Micron is +3–4% premarket [3,4,5]. **NQ is +0.37–0.41% (~29,923–29,934) at 8:35–8:37 AM ET**, near the top of a 29,783.75–29,989.25 overnight range [2,3]. With a ~161-pt futures premium, that implies a cash open near ~29,765, **above Tuesday's 29,720 NDX high**, an upside range extension [1,2]. Macro is mixed. The 10-year is pinned at ~4.99–5.01% [6,7]. Oil is **up ~2%** (WTI ~$102, Brent ~$111) on conflicting US–Iran headlines, a headwind [6,7]. The dollar is flat at ~102.3 [6]. This morning's data was minor: the September goods trade deficit widened to −$134.9B (consensus about −$129B) and wholesale inventories rose 0.6% (consensus 0.4%) [9]. The real risk comes later: the **FOMC decision at 2:00 PM** (hold priced at ~90%; ~75% odds of a December hike) and Warsh's 2:30 press conference, then **Microsoft and Alphabet after the close** [4,5,8]. Last night's chip/storage reports were sold (NXP −9%, Seagate −6%) [10]. So the call is **a small LONG while NQ holds above Tuesday's high zone, out on a loss of Tuesday's settle**, and expect the move to fade into the Fed.

bullets.label: The gap is up, and it's above Tuesday's high.
bullets.text: NQ is +0.4% and trading in the upper half of its 29,783.75–29,989.25 overnight range [2,3]. On a ~161-pt premium, that implies a cash open around ~29,765, just above Tuesday's 29,720 NDX high, so the rebound from last week's AI selloff is extending for a third day [1,2]. That's an estimate, not a quote.

bullets.label: A fresh chip catalyst.
bullets.text: SK Hynix reported record Q3 revenue (KRW 104.6tln) and operating profit (KRW 83.3tln), plus a ~KRW 100tln shareholder return, and said AI memory demand stays tight until at least 2030 [4,5,7]. Micron is +3–4%, AMD/Marvell/Intel ~+2%, Nvidia +0.8% premarket; Alphabet +1.2% on a report that OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips [3,4]. NQ is outperforming ES and YM [3,7].

bullets.label: Macro is mixed.
bullets.text: The 10-year is flat at ~5.00% and VIX is slightly lower at ~17.4 [6,7]. Oil is up ~2% (WTI ~$102) on conflicting reports about a Qatari peace proposal to Iran and a WSJ report that the US told Gulf states to prepare for a short campaign after the midterms [6,7]. The dollar is flat at ~102.3 [6]. The 8:30 data (wider goods deficit, firmer wholesale inventories) is low impact [9].

bullets.label: The morning is the only clean window.
bullets.text: Still to come: EIA crude stocks (10:30 AM), the Fed decision (2:00 PM) and Warsh's press conference (2:30 PM), with no other Fed speakers [5,8]. GE Vernova, Boston Scientific and T-Mobile report before the open; Microsoft, Alphabet, ServiceNow, eBay and Chipotle after the close [4,5]. Amazon reports Thursday, Apple on Nov 2; Meta already reported Oct 21 [11].

bullets.label: Bull case:
bullets.text: Back-to-back NDX gains (+1.1%, +1.3%) after the AI selloff, a strong chip catalyst, and a gap above Tuesday's high with VIX easing [1,4,6]. A ~90%-priced Fed hold removes one surprise, and positioning into Microsoft/Alphabet cloud results could lift NDX back to the 29,823–29,928 levels from before the Oct 22 selloff [1,8].

bullets.label: Bear case:
bullets.text: It's a third gap-up in a row straight into the Fed and two megacap reports, a classic setup for a fade or chop before 2:00 PM. Last night's chip/storage reports were sold despite beats (NXP −9%, Seagate −6%), so buyers aren't rewarding every print [10]. Oil is up 2%, the 10-year is sitting right on 5%, markets price at least three more hikes by late 2027, and Warsh could lean hawkish [4,5,7]. Dow futures are lower, so the bid is narrow [3,5].

bullets.label: Stay/scale LONG:
bullets.text: Cash NDX holds above Tuesday's 29,720 high (≈ NQ 29,880) through the first 30 min. Add on a break of the NQ overnight high 29,989.25 / 30,000, ideally with SMH green and the 10-year under 5.00%.

bullets.label: Flip to SHORT:
bullets.text: NQ fills the gap and loses Tuesday's settle (29,812.00; ≈ NDX 29,651). Stronger below the overnight low (29,783.75), especially if WTI moves above ~$103 or the 10-year holds above 5.00%.

bullets.label: Flip to STAND ASIDE:
bullets.text: If the open stalls in the 29,812–29,880 NQ band (between Tuesday's settle and its high) with no follow-through, there's no edge. Go flat well before the 2:00 PM Fed decision either way.

bullets.label: Wildcards:
bullets.text: US–Iran/Gulf headlines and oil, the EIA crude report at 10:30 AM, any Fed leak, Anthropic IPO news (Sen. Warren's questions), and early read-throughs into Microsoft/Alphabet results [5,7].
